widgets_values:
Required models (LOCAL — already on disk):

MOSS Image DiT:  moss_image_sft_int8_convrot.safetensors (diffusion_models/)
Text Encoder:    qwen3.5_9b_int8_convrot.safetensors (text_encoders/, type: moss_image)
VAE:             flux2_vae.safetensors (vae/)
Turbo LoRA:      MOSS/MOSS-Image-SFT-8-steps-dmd.safetensors (loras/MOSS/)

SeedVR2 upscale branch removed (SeedVR2-Sharp weights not available locally).
Generation runs at 8 steps / CFG 1.0 via the Turbo (DMD) LoRA.

Moss Image Model: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image/tree/main/diffusion_models

VAE: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image/tree/main/vae

int8 convrot gives x3 faster boost speed
